secrets.name: OMEGA_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /v1/attest (>=32 chars). A dev placeholder is provided in .env.base44-defaults; replace with a real random key for trustworthy attestations.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Claude API key for the Invisible Online Computer (console.anthropic.com). Preferred ELION provider. Without it the computer returns UNKNOWN instead of a fabricated VERIFIED.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com) used when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent or OMEGA_LLM_PROVIDER=openai.
